title: Assertion: At Most 2 Outstanding
constraints: `req` pulses issue transactions and `rsp` pulses complete them (one per pulse). At most **2** transactions may be outstanding.
Rule 1: a `req` without a `rsp` in the same cycle is illegal when 2 are already outstanding. Rule 2: a `rsp` is illegal when nothing is outstanding (before this cycle).
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Properties can't count by themselves: keep an auxiliary counter (`cnt <= cnt + req - rsp`) and assert on it.
Auxiliary modeling code like this is standard practice in formal and simulation checkers.
